args: import json,hashlib,sys;from pathlib import Path;a=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes());h=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper();assert all(h(x['path'])==x['sha256'] for x in a['compilerBinaries'].values());assert all(h(s['currentContract']['path'])==s['currentContract']['sha256'] and h(s['originalContract']['path'])==s['originalContract']['sha256'] and all(h(p)==v for p,v in s['currentSourcePins'].items()) for s in a['suites']);assert all(not Path(s[k]).exists() for s in a['suites'] for k in ['managedOutput','nativeOutput']);rv=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes());assert not rv['missingReview'] and not rv['changedWithoutCurrentReview'];assert all(h(p)==v for p,v in rv['sourceHashes'].items());print('CURRENT_PRODUCTS_UNCHANGED_ORACLES_SOURCE_REVIEW_AND_EMPTY_OUTPUTS_PASSED');assert json.loads(Path(sys.argv[3]).read_bytes())['status']=='completed','PRIOR_FOCUSED83_NOT_COMPLETE';print('PRIOR_COMPLETION_RESOURCE_GATE_PASSED')
